title: James Clerk Maxwell: A Treatise on Electricity and Magnetism, Volume I Source-Witnessed LaTeX Working Tranches
description:
Dedicated James Clerk Maxwell working-edition record for A Treatise on Electricity and Magnetism, Volume I. This version adds the pp.001-059 web/promo index closeout package and the pp.060-079 source-witnessed continuation package while retaining the compact pp.001-059 source-verification checkpoint package, the IA master-image index/source-intake helper, and earlier ledger-backed source-witnessed working tranches for book pages 95-101, 103, 105, 109, and the main continuous run 111-267.

Status at a glance. This is not a complete Treatise edition, not a critical edition, and not a final mathematical certification. It should be cited as source-witnessed working tranches. The pp.001-059 closeout package contains cumulative pp.001-059 TeX/PDF/log, pp.058-059 closeout TeX/PDF/log, JP2 master leaves pp.001-059, p059 source/render images, figure crops, updated page-completion index, math index, notation-token register, source-verification logbook, notation heuristic diary, editorial choices CSV, structural audit, build-log diagnostics, checksums, and p59 visual closeout audit. It closes the previous p.059 register/index refresh note for this tranche.

The pp.060-079 package continues the IA 1873 first-edition source-witnessed sequence and includes current pp.060-079 TeX/PDF/log, cumulative pp.001-079 TeX/PDF/log, IA 500-PPI JP2 source leaves, source preview PDFs, current view JPGs, display inventory, notation delta, editorial-choice ledger, reverify page log, source availability audit, render contact sheets, and selected source-vs-edition checks. Its internal completion bar reports pp.001-079 closed, 79/467 source-map pages, or 16.9 percent, with next continuation at printed p.080 / IA leaf 118. A future source gap is reported at printed p.463 / IA leaf 501, outside the current tranche.

Source-check ledgers and source witness images govern promoted range claims. OCR/XML material is used as a locator/witness layer, not as textual authority. The large missing-source supplement ZIPs remain provenance candidates and are not included in this compact Maxwell satellite update.

Corrections and contributions. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through the GitHub mirror via issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
notes: Adds Maxwell_WebPromo_Index_Closeout_p001_059_20260613.zip and Maxwell_Vol1_pp060_079_cum_scans_20260613.zip. The first closes the p.059 register/index refresh for the pp.001-059 tranche; the second continues the IA 1873 first-edition source-witnessed Maxwell Vol. I sequence through printed pp.060-079 and includes cumulative pp.001-079 TeX/PDF/logs plus source witnesses and audit/register material. This extends the compact promoted sequence to pp.001-079, 79/467 pages or 16.9 percent of the uploaded source map. Not a complete Treatise edition, not a critical edition, and not a certified mathematical edition; read as source-witnessed working tranches. Continue at printed p.080 / IA leaf 118. Large missing-source supplement ZIPs are not included in this compact satellite update because they are provenance/witness candidates rather than new promoted TeX coverage.
